To find the average speed of the train, we must use the formula:

$$ \text{Average Speed} = \frac{\text{Total Distance}}{\text{Total Time}} $$

**Note:** Average speed is **not** the arithmetic mean of the two speeds. It is the total distance traveled divided by the total time taken.

Add the distances traveled in both segments of the trip.

$$ \text{Distance}_1 = 120 \text{ km} $$
$$ \text{Distance}_2 = 200 \text{ km} $$

$$ \text{Total Distance} = 120 \text{ km} + 200 \text{ km} = 320 \text{ km} $$
